name: KUCINGKO
recent: KUCINGKO 近期有多名董事在闭门期前申报持股意向，同时一名执行董事在闭门期外增持 5 万股。新闻指出公司亏损收窄，新收入来源逐步成形。
notable: 执行董事 Ooi Kok Hong 于 2026-10-23 以每股 RM0.085 增持 50,000 股。
多名董事在闭门期前申报可能交易持股的意向。
risks: 董事在闭门期前申报交易意向，可能涉及在业绩公布前买卖股份。

news.title: Kucingko's Recovery Gathers Pace as Losses Narrow and New Revenue Streams Take Shape

recent_en: KUCINGKO recently saw several directors declare their intention to deal during the closed period, while an executive director acquired 50,000 shares outside the closed period. News reports that losses are narrowing and new revenue streams are taking shape.
notable_en: Executive Director Ooi Kok Hong acquired 50,000 shares at RM0.085 per share on 23 Oct 2026.
Several directors declared their intention to potentially deal in shares ahead of the closed period.
risks_en: Directors declared intentions to deal ahead of the closed period, which may involve trading shares before results announcement.
